expectations.text: Notification to the competent supervisory authority without undue delay and where feasible within 72 hours of becoming aware (Art. 33(1)), with phased notification permitted if information is incomplete
expectations.evidence: Step 3: "Notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours (Art. 33)"; clock starts at awareness; "Art. 33(1) explicitly permits phased/staggered reporting"

expectations.text: Applies the risk threshold correctly: notification required unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals; exfiltration of customer data plainly meets the threshold
expectations.evidence: Concludes notification is required but never states the Art. 33(1) threshold rule (notification required unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals)

expectations.text: Communication to affected data subjects without undue delay when the breach is likely to result in a high risk (Art. 34), with the exceptions (e.g., effective encryption, subsequent measures)
expectations.evidence: Step 4: Art. 34 "likely to result in a high risk" triggers communication "without undue delay"; Art. 34(3) exemptions (encryption, subsequent measures, disproportionate effort/public communication) covered

expectations.text: Internal documentation duty for all breaches regardless of notification (Art. 33(5))
expectations.evidence: Step 6: "Maintain an internal breach register covering all breaches, even those not requiring SA notification (Art. 33(5))"

expectations.text: Correct role handling: if acting as processor, notify the controller without undue delay (Art. 33(2)); mentions notification content elements (nature, categories/approximate numbers, DPO contact, likely consequences, measures)
expectations.evidence: Notification content elements (nature, numbers, DPO contact, consequences, measures) are given, but the processor role - Art. 33(2) duty to notify the controller without undue delay - is never mentioned
